title: Malaysian Satay Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic Malaysian-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken, served with a peanut sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended mixture and a pinch of salt. Add the chicken breast and coat evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, if using.
Grill the chicken for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through. Transfer to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the peanut sauce (if using) in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the grilled chicken with the peanut sauce spooned over the top. Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
Optional: Serve with satay peanut sauce on the side for dipping.
